title: Ask a coding agent for a recipe

scenes.heading: Ask a configuration question
voice: You need the GPU driver version for an EKS training cluster.
Ask your coding agent the question.

scenes.heading: Teach the agent the AICR CLI
voice: Generate the skill for Codex using the AICR CLI.
It gives the agent command and option references for resolving GPU recipes and inspecting selected settings.

scenes.heading: Turn the question into a query
scenes.sub: Make the criteria and selector visible
voice: Specify EKS, H100, Ubuntu, and training in your request.
The agent can use the skill to build a command that selects the driver version from the resolved AICR recipe.

scenes.heading: Ask to see the evidence
scenes.sub: Keep the command with the answer
voice: Have the agent show both the returned value and the command it used.
You can rerun that command against the same catalog and check the answer yourself.

viewer: Platform engineer investigating a recipe with a coding agent
payoff: A plain-English GPU question becomes an auditable AICR command and a catalog-resolved value.
